editorial:
Imagine being stuck at home with just your cat while the world outside turns into a nightmare. That is exactly where Manel finds himself when a strange rabies outbreak starts turning people into violent, mindless creatures. Instead of running right away, he hunkers down, using his smarts to stay safe. But food runs out, and soon he has to step outside, traveling by land and sea while dodging danger at every turn. The movie has a quiet, tense feel at first, then shifts into a survival road trip that keeps you on edge. It is less about big explosions and more about one man trying to stay alive with his furry friend.

The acting is solid, especially the lead, who makes you care about Manel and his cat. The action scenes are gritty and realistic, and the pacing moves well once the journey begins. On the downside, some parts feel slow, and a few side characters are not very memorable. Still, if you enjoy survival stories with heart, this one is worth your time.
endingExplained: By the end, Manel finally reaches a safe island community after a dangerous sea crossing. He and his cat make it through, but not without losses along the way. The final twist reveals that the infection may not be fully contained, hinting that the danger is far from over. Still, Manel finds a small group of survivors and a glimmer of hope. The last shot shows him looking out at the water, ready to keep fighting for a better tomorrow.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves survival horror and zombie stories with heart.
